name: ROSE Robotics

typography.family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

motion.systemStudy: three full-viewport horizontal panels on desktop, vertical flow on compact and reduced-motion modes
motion.reducedMotion: static product composition with no smooth scroll, scroll reveal, pointer parallax, articulation, or camera travel

components.primaryButton: signal rose pill, near-white text, directional icon, 46px minimum height
components.floatingNavigation: inset translucent semantic surface with centered section links
components.kinematicReadout: phase-aware model label, articulation callouts, and compact four-state rail
components.systemStudyRail: joint, tooling, and control-loop panels pinned into a reversible horizontal sequence
components.contentSurface: 14px semantic card with one-pixel border and layout-specific composition
components.waitlistForm: persistent label, email field, primary action, live status, local-only disclosure

rules: Signal Rose marks action or articulation only.
All unconfirmed claims, specifications, and renders are labeled as placeholders.
Dark mode preserves hierarchy rather than inverting mechanically.
